===== postgres/marts.fct_orders/load.default.sql =====
-- dbdatabuild rendered load operation. Generated by `render --write`; do not edit.
-- model:           marts.fct_orders
-- operation:       default
-- connection:      postgres
-- strategy:        delete_insert_by_key
-- definition hash: 73c24ac7a06fff501b4b69301f6410951857df75cda1267627f9e84ab56af541
-- parameters:      none
BEGIN;
CREATE TEMP TABLE ddb_stage AS
WITH ddb_body AS (WITH recent AS (SELECT * FROM staging.orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)) SELECT r.order_id, r.customer_id, r.amount FROM recent AS r ORDER BY r.order_id)
SELECT "order_id", "customer_id", "amount" FROM ddb_body;
DELETE FROM "marts"."fct_orders" AS tgt WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ddb_stage AS src WHERE src."order_id" = tgt."order_id");
INSERT INTO "marts"."fct_orders" ("order_id", "customer_id", "amount")
SELECT "order_id", "customer_id", "amount" FROM ddb_stage;
DROP TABLE ddb_stage;
COMMIT;
